THE TRUE H4 = h4_cone_packing (SEALED) + an aperture supplier. What is missing is not the packing and not the half-plane; it is the cyclic-order fact that the hull cone at p (i+1) is spanned by p i and p (i+2). That fact lives in H2/H3, not H4.
repair: Re-freeze H4 carrying H3's binders verbatim (v0 in interior, hne, the `< pi` consecutive-gap clause, the `= 2 * pi` central-sum clause), which force p to be the argument-sorted listing about an interior point; then discharge it by feeding h4_cone_packing an aperture. Alternatively drop the listing entirely and use h4_cone_packing as the rung, since it is already the general statement.
witness_b_convex_quadrilateral: S = {(0,0),(1,0),(10,1),(0,1)}, all four strict maximisers of explicit functionals so all four are hull vertices and the hull has nonempty interior; p = (1,0),(0,0),(10,1),(0,1), period 4; i = 0 gives w = (0,0), udeg = 2 (neighbours (1,0),(0,1)), angle (1,0) (0,0) (10,1) = arctan(1/10) < pi/3, bound reads 2 <= 1 + 3*(<pi/3)/pi < 2.
